## Complete Report: Projectile Instantiation & Destruction in `WenJianGamejam_2026`

---

### 1. Prefab Paths

| Prefab | Full Path |
|---|---|
| **Bullet.prefab** | `Assets/Prefab/Bullet/Bullet.prefab` |
| **ErodeProjectile.prefab** | `Assets/Prefab/Bullet/ErodeProjectile.prefab` |
| **ErodeHitEffect.prefab** | `Assets/Prefab/Bullet/ErodeHitEffect.prefab` |

Both the standard bullet prefab and the ErodeProjectile prefab exist under `Assets/Prefab/Bullet/`.

---

### 2. ALL Instantiate Calls (4 locations, 5 files)

#### 2a. `PlayerCombat.cs` — Player shooting
- **File:** `Assets/Scripts/Player/PlayerCombat.cs` **Line 47**
- **Code:**
  ```csharp
  GameObject bullet = Instantiate(bulletPrefab, transform.position, Quaternion.identity);
  Projectile proj = bullet.GetComponent<Projectile>();
  ```
- **Prefab used:** `bulletPrefab` (serialized field, assigned in Inspector — points to `Bullet.prefab`)
- **Initialization:** Calls `proj.Initialize(direction, bulletSpeed, attackStrength, OwnerType.Player, gameObject)`
- **Note:** The prefab is expected to already have a `Projectile` component. If missing, only a warning is logged.

#### 2b. `RangedAttack.cs` — Enemy ranged attack
- **File:** `Assets/Scripts/Enemy/Behaviors/RangedAttack.cs` **Line 33**
- **Code:**
  ```csharp
  GameObject obj = Instantiate(projectilePrefab, spawnPos, Quaternion.identity);
  Projectile proj = obj.GetComponent<Projectile>();
  ```
- **Prefab used:** `projectilePrefab` (serialized public field, assigned per enemy)
- **Initialization:** Calls `proj.Initialize(dir, projectileSpeed, damage, projectileOwnerType, gameObject)` if `Projectile` component exists.

#### 2c. `ProjectileSkillEffect.cs` — Skill system projectile spawning
- **File:** `Assets/Scripts/Skill/Effects/ProjectileSkillEffect.cs` **Line 59**
- **Code:**
  ```csharp
  GameObject go = Instantiate(projectilePrefab, pos, Quaternion.identity);
  Projectile proj = go.GetComponent<Projectile>();
  if (proj == null) proj = go.AddComponent<Projectile>();
  ```
- **Prefab used:** `projectilePrefab` (serialized field on the `ProjectileSkillEffect` ScriptableObject)
- **Key difference:** If the prefab does NOT have a `Projectile` component, one is **added automatically** at runtime. Supports scatter (multiple projectiles in a spread).

#### 2d. `SkillLibrary.cs` — Legacy fallback path
- **File:** `Assets/Scripts/Skill/SkillLibrary.cs` **Line 51**
- **Code:**
  ```csharp
  GameObject go = Instantiate(data.projectilePrefab,
      caster.CasterTransform.position, Quaternion.identity);
  Projectile proj = go.GetComponent<Projectile>();
  if (proj == null) proj = go.AddComponent<Projectile>();
  ```
- **Prefab used:** `data.projectilePrefab` (from `SkillData` ScriptableObject)
- **Note:** This is a **legacy/fallback** path — only used when `data.skillEffect` is null. Same auto-add logic as `ProjectileSkillEffect`.

#### 2e. (Bonus) `ErodeProjectile.OnDestroy` — Hit effect instantiation
- **File:** `Assets/Scripts/Skill/ConcreteSkill/ErodeProjectile.cs` **Line 34** (inside `OnDestroy`)
- **Code:**
  ```csharp
  if (hitEffectPrefab != null)
  {
      Instantiate(hitEffectPrefab, transform.position, Quaternion.identity);
  }
  ```
- **Purpose:** Spawns a visual hit effect (`ErodeHitEffect.prefab`) when the projectile is destroyed.

---

### 3. ALL Destroy Calls (5 locations, 3 files)

#### 3a. `Projectile.cs` — 3 Destroy paths
**File:** `Assets/Scripts/Bullet/Projectile.cs`

| Line | Trigger | Code |
|---|---|---|
| **L49** | Collision with `Obstacles` tag | `Destroy(gameObject);` |
| **L62** | Collision with valid target (enemy or player) after dealing damage | `Destroy(gameObject);` |
| **L68** | `OnBecameInvisible()` (projectile leaves camera view) | `Destroy(gameObject);` |
| **(L42)** | Time-based lifetime (inside `Initialize()`) | `Destroy(gameObject, lifeTime);` (default `lifeTime = 3f`) |

#### 3b. `RangedAttack.cs` — Fallback destroy
**File:** `Assets/Scripts/Enemy/Behaviors/RangedAttack.cs` **Line 42**
- **Code:** `Destroy(obj, projectileLifetime);`
- **Condition:** Only executed if the spawned projectile prefab does **NOT** have a `Projectile` component. This is a fallback so the object doesn't live forever.

#### 3c. `ErodeProjectile.cs` — OnDestroy handler (no direct Destroy call)
**File:** `Assets/Scripts/Skill/ConcreteSkill/ErodeProjectile.cs`
- **No explicit `Destroy(gameObject)` call** — the `ErodeProjectile` component is destroyed when the `Projectile` component destroys the GameObject (see 3a). The `OnDestroy()` method in `ErodeProjectile` handles:
  - Spawning hit effect (`ErodeHitEffect.prefab`)
  - Detaching trail particles (`TrailParticles` child) so they persist after the projectile is gone.

---

### 4. SkillData Assets Referencing Projectile Prefabs

| Asset File | References Prefab |
|---|---|
| `Erode.asset` | `ErodeProjectile.prefab` (guid: `cb7626f45aa598148b965d346a3f95f8`) |
| `ErodeProjectileEffect.asset` | `ErodeProjectile.prefab` (same guid) |
| `ProjectileEffect.asset` | `Bullet.prefab` (guid: `9da0862d54697774ea6e8293350078a7`) |

The `Erode.asset` skill has both `projectilePrefab` (ErodeProjectile) and `skillEffect` (ErodeProjectileEffect) set, so the `SkillLibrary` code will use the `skillEffect.Execute()` path (2c) rather than the legacy fallback (2d).

---

### 5. Summary of Lifecycle Flow

```
Instantiation (4 entry points):
  PlayerCombat.TryShoot()          → bulletPrefab    → Bullet.prefab
  RangedAttack.TryAttack()         → projectilePrefab → (varies per enemy)
  ProjectileSkillEffect.SpawnOne() → projectilePrefab → (varies per skill effect)
  SkillLibrary (legacy fallback)   → data.projectilePrefab → (varies per skill data)

Destruction (5 mechanisms):
  Projectile.OnTriggerEnter2D (Obstacles)  → Destroy(gameObject)
  Projectile.OnTriggerEnter2D (valid hit)  → Destroy(gameObject)
  Projectile.OnBecameInvisible()           → Destroy(gameObject)
  Projectile.Initialize() timer            → Destroy(gameObject, lifeTime)
  RangedAttack (fallback, no Projectile)   → Destroy(obj, projectileLifetime)

ErodeProjectile special handling:
  OnDestroy() → spawns hit effect, detaches trail particles, then the GameObject is gone
```
